rationale: The Latin anchors are decisive here: *maritus* (husband) and the direct quotation *voca virum tuum* ("call your husband") from John 4:16–17 confirm that CEORL in this definition means specifically a husband/spouse, not merely an adult male. Synset man.n.08 ("a male person who plays a significant role, husband or lover or boyfriend, in the life of a particular woman") matches this spousal sense most precisely.
